data.one_liner: A WebView2-powered webview implementation for the Windows platform.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter webview plugin for Windows built on Microsoft Edge WebView2. It renders web content off-screen and integrates it into Flutter apps using Windows graphics capture.
use_when: You need to display web content inside a Flutter application targeting Windows.
You require MS Edge WebView2 capabilities on Windows 10 (1809+) and above.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Windows, such as Android or iOS.
Your users are on older Windows versions that do not support the required runtime.
strengths: Full-screen and high-DPI screen support on Windows.
Supports script execution, virtual hostname mapping, and multi-touch/trackpad scrolling.
Provides streams for loading state and web messages.
weaknesses: Requires the external WebView2 Runtime to be installed on the user's system.
Older Windows versions are not supported due to relying on Windows.Graphics.Capture API.
data.setup_notes: Requires Visual Studio 2019 or higher, Windows 11 SDK, and the WebView2 Runtime installed on target machines.
